integrity: The general statements are proved algebraically. Finite exact computations are supplementary checks only and are not used to infer infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the rational exceptional j-locus for the stated split-cubic normalization and gives one infinite scaled D(n) family; it does not classify all integral harmonic triples, prove a fixed-n infinitude, or give density results for the finite-field cofactor condition.
title: Exceptional \(j=1728\) locus for split-cubic \(D(n)\)-triples
